name: mcp-rule34
description: MCP server for rule34.xxx. Search posts by tag through the site's own API. Requires a rule34.xxx API key.
long_description: Search rule34.xxx by one tag or several at once, ask for images, animations or video, and get each post's page, file, dimensions, score, rating and tags, with the total for the whole search. Requires the API key rule34.xxx issues per account.

user_id.title: rule34.xxx user id
user_id.description: The numeric id shown under API Access Credentials on your account options page.

api_key.title: rule34.xxx API key
api_key.description: The key shown under API Access Credentials. The site issues one per person.

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Find posts carrying a tag, or several tags at once.

tags.description: Tags a post must all carry, such as ['asuka langley sohryu', 'black hair'].

any_of.description: Tags a post must carry at least one of.

exclude.description: Tags a post must not carry, such as ['monochrome'] to leave out black and white.

media_type.description: 'image' for stills, 'animated' for GIFs, 'video' for MP4. The site states this in its own tags, so the classification is as good as the tagging.

rating.description: The two ratings rule34.xxx holds. Leave unset to search both.

sort.description: 'score' is the site's own tally of votes, recomputed once a day. 'id' is newest first. 'updated' is by when a post last changed, which retagging moves. 'random' draws a different set on each call.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Read one post whole, with a kind for every tag.

id.description: The post's numeric id, as a search returns it.

url.description: A link to the post's page, such as https://rule34.xxx/index.php?page=post&s=view&id=2195419. The link is read rather than followed.

tools.name: find_tags
tools.description: Find how rule34.xxx spells a tag, and how many posts carry it.

query.description: The start of a tag name, such as 'kimagure' or 'prince of tennis'. Spaces are joined with underscores.
